name: Bael'dun Keep
summary: Dwarven forces hold Bael'dun Keep above the Bael Modan excavation in the southern Barrens. Under General Twinbraid, the keep anchors the Alliance's contested presence and draws the surrounding Horde into violent conflict.

sections.title: A Dwarven Stronghold in Kalimdor
sections.body: Bael'dun Keep guards the Bael Modan excavation in the southern Barrens. Dwarven architect Haggis Boatmurder designed the stronghold to protect the Prospectors and archaeologists searching the trenches for ancient titan artifacts. Ironworks and artillery arm its garrison. From here, the dwarves watch the area, secure their supply lines, and carry Alliance military power into Kalimdor's heartland.

sections.title: A Flashpoint of Bloodshed
sections.body: The keep and its adjoining digsite drove the local Stonespire tribe of tauren from their ancestral home. Bael'dun remains a flashpoint in the Barrens, and nearby Horde outposts see it as a brazen military intrusion. Gann Stonespire wages a personal war of vengeance against the invaders. Aggrieved tauren, opportunistic scouts, and suspicious outposts such as Camp Taurajo keep the fortress under threat of raids and sabotage.

faq.answer: Dwarven soldiers hold Bael'dun Keep for the Alliance and Ironforge's Explorers' League. General Twinbraid commands them.

faq.q: Why is Bael'dun Keep built in the southern Barrens?
aliases: why are dwarves in the barrens
faq.answer: The Alliance built Bael'dun Keep to defend Bael Modan. The massive archaeological expedition seeks titan relics and ancient dwarven origins in Kalimdor.

faq.q: Why are the local tauren attacking Bael'dun Keep?
faq.answer: The excavation and fortress drove the Stonespire tauren from their ancestral grounds. Survivors such as Gann Stonespire seek vengeance and the destruction of the dwarven invaders.

faq.q: Who was the architect of the fortress?
faq.answer: Dwarven architectural records name Haggis Boatmurder as the architect who designed and built the fortress.

angles.text: Bael'dun Keep occupies land taken from the Stonespire tribe, a reminder of Alliance encroachment on your homeland.
Bael'dun Keep anchors your military presence in the southern Barrens. It guards the Explorers' League's vital discoveries against hostile Horde forces.
